# Python install manager [...] The installer we offer for Windows is being replaced by our new install manager, which can be installed from the Windows Store or from its download page. Python 3.14.8 is an expedited security release and the eighth maintenance release of 3.14, containing around 354 bugfixes, build improvements and documentation changes from 142 contributors since 3.14.7.

## Security content in this release [...] For more details on the changes to Python 3.14, see What’s new in Python 3.14.

### Build changes

 PEP 761: Python 3.14 and onwards no longer provides PGP signatures for release artifacts. Instead, Sigstore is recommended for verifiers.
 Official macOS and Windows release binaries include an experimental JIT compiler.
 Official Android binary releases are now available.
